f.title: Vaccine MAH is responsible for vaccine safety, efficacy and quality controllability
f.statement: Vaccine MAHs shall strengthen whole-lifecycle quality management of vaccines and are responsible for vaccine safety, efficacy and quality controllability.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人应当加强疫苗全生命周期质量管理，对疫苗的安全性、有效性和质量可控性负责。
rows.review_note: Review: no change (in-force date added to applicability). Double-check: quote proves the MAH responsibility; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: The vaccine marketing authorisation holder shall strengthen quality management over the whole life cycle of vaccines and is responsible for the safety, efficacy and quality controllability of vaccines.

f.title: Keep vaccine information authentic, accurate, complete and traceable throughout the process
f.statement: Entities and individuals engaged in vaccine development, production, distribution and vaccination, including the vaccine MAH, shall comply with laws, regulations, rules, standards and norms, ensure that information across the whole process is authentic, accurate, complete and traceable, bear legal responsibility and accept public supervision.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Vaccine marketing authorisation holder and other entities engaged in vaccine activities
rows.quote: 从事疫苗研制、生产、流通和预防接种活动的单位和个人，应当遵守法律、法规、规章、标准和规范，保证全过程信息真实、准确、完整和可追溯，依法承担责任，接受社会监督。
rows.review_note: Review: added (missed). Article 5(2) general data-integrity duty, which covers safety and AEFI information. Double-check: quote proves the general information-integrity duty; MAH is within "units and individuals" (inferred); English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 86: MAH covered by 单位和个人 by inference.
rows.quote_en: Entities and individuals engaged in vaccine research and development, production, distribution and vaccination activities shall comply with laws, regulations, rules, standards and norms, ensure that information throughout the whole process is authentic, accurate, complete and traceable, bear responsibility according to law and accept public supervision.

f.title: Vaccine trial sponsor must set up a clinical trial safety monitoring and evaluation system
f.statement: The vaccine clinical trial sponsor shall develop the clinical trial protocol, establish a clinical trial safety monitoring and evaluation system, carefully select subjects, reasonably set subject groups and age groups, and take effective measures according to the degree of risk to protect subjects.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗临床试验申办者应当制定临床试验方案，建立临床试验安全监测与评价制度，审慎选择受试者，合理设置受试者群体和年龄组，并根据风险程度采取有效措施，保护受试者合法权益。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the sponsor duties; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: The sponsor of a vaccine clinical trial shall formulate the clinical trial protocol, establish a clinical trial safety monitoring and evaluation system, select subjects prudently, set subject populations and age groups reasonably, and take effective measures according to the degree of risk to protect the lawful rights and interests of subjects.

f.title: Definition: abnormal reaction to vaccination (预防接种异常反应) and its exclusions
f.statement: Definition (not a stand-alone duty): an abnormal reaction to vaccination (预防接种异常反应, often rendered AEFI) is an adverse drug reaction in which a qualified vaccine, during or after standard vaccination, damages the recipient's tissues, organs or functions with no party at fault. Excluded are: (1) common reactions after vaccination caused by the vaccine's inherent properties; (2) harm caused by vaccine quality problems; (3) harm caused by the vaccination unit breaching vaccination work norms, immunization schedules, vaccine use guidelines or vaccination plans; (4) coincidental onset where the recipient was in the incubation or prodromal period of a disease; (5) acute recurrence or worsening of a pre-existing disease where the recipient had a contraindication in the package insert and the recipient or guardian did not truthfully disclose health status and contraindications; (6) individual or group psychogenic reactions. The term is used in the MAH duty to collect and report suspected cases (Article 54(2)) and in the compensation scheme (Article 56).
f.clause: 第五十二条 (Article 52), Chapter VI AEFI monitoring
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.actor: Vaccine marketing authorisation holder (in applying AEFI duties)
rows.quote:
预防接种异常反应，是指合格的疫苗在实施规范接种过程中或者实施规范接种后造成受种者机体组织器官、功能损害，相关各方均无过错的药品不良反应。 
　　下列情形不属于预防接种异常反应： 
　　（一）因疫苗本身特性引起的接种后一般反应； 
　　（二）因疫苗质量问题给受种者造成的损害； 
　　（三）因接种单位违反预防接种工作规范、免疫程序、疫苗使用指导原则、接种方案给受种者造成的损害； 
　　（四）受种者在接种时正处于某种疾病的潜伏期或者前驱期，接种后偶合发病； 
　　（五）受种者有疫苗说明书规定的接种禁忌，在接种前受种者或者其监护人未如实提供受种者的健康状况和接种禁忌等情况，接种后受种者原有疾病急性复发或者病情加重； 
　　（六）因心理因素发生的个体或者群体的心因性反应。
rows.location: 第五十二条 (Article 52), Chapter VI AEFI monitoring
rows.review_note: Review: added (missed). Binding statutory definition that sets which events are AEFIs for MAH monitoring and compensation, so it is recorded as Mandatory per GUIDE.md. Double-check: scope narrowed: 预防接种异常反应 is the statutory no-fault vaccination reaction used for compensation; the MAH duty in Article 54(2) is to collect and report suspected (疑似) cases, so the definition does not limit what the MAH collects. Removed the claim that it sets the scope of MAH collection and the uncited Article 73/78 note. Mandatory kept per GUIDE (binding statutory definition used by reporting and compensation duties), but relevance to reporting is indirect; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 70: definition only; reporting relevance indirect.

f.title: Set up a dedicated AEFI unit, actively collect and analyse suspected AEFIs, take risk control measures and report
f.statement: Vaccine MAHs shall set up a dedicated body with full-time staff to actively collect, follow up and analyse suspected adverse events following immunization (AEFI), promptly take risk control measures, report suspected AEFIs to the centres for disease control and prevention, and submit quality analysis reports to the provincial drug regulatory department.
f.clause: 第五十四条第二款 (Article 54(2)), Chapter VI AEFI monitoring
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up; Submission operations; Risk management & minimisation

rows.deadline: Promptly (及时) take risk control measures; this Article sets no reporting time frame
rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人应当设立专门机构，配备专职人员，主动收集、跟踪分析疑似预防接种异常反应，及时采取风险控制措施，将疑似预防接种异常反应向疾病预防控制机构报告，将质量分析报告提交省、自治区、直辖市人民政府药品监督管理部门。
rows.location: 第五十四条第二款 (Article 54(2)), Chapter VI AEFI monitoring
rows.review_note: Review: deadline corrected. The MAH sentence has no 'as per regulations' qualifier and no reporting clock; only the risk control measures must be 'promptly' (及时). Double-check: quote proves actor, duties and "promptly" for risk control; no reporting clock in the Law; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Vaccine marketing authorisation holders shall set up a dedicated body, staff it with full-time personnel, actively collect, follow up and analyse suspected abnormal reactions to vaccination, take risk-control measures promptly, report suspected abnormal reactions to vaccination to the centres for disease control and prevention, and submit quality analysis reports to the drug regulatory department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government.

f.title: Bear AEFI compensation costs for non-programme vaccines
f.statement: Compensation costs for adverse reactions following non-immunization-programme vaccines are borne by the relevant vaccine MAH.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100). Non-immunization-programme vaccines.

rows.quote: 接种非免疫规划疫苗所需的补偿费用，由相关疫苗上市许可持有人承担。
rows.review_note: Review: kept in PV scope. AEFI compensation for non-programme vaccines is an MAH safety obligation and the quote names the MAH. The compensation scope, standards and procedure are set by the State Council (Article 56(3)), and the AEFI definition is in Article 52. Added case-processing as a secondary process (AEFI case linkage). Double-check: cost-allocation clause (由...承担) without a modal verb, so Mandatory is a judgement; PV relevance is indirect; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: fixed (quote_en dropped 接种...所需, 'required for vaccination with'; wording restored); held at 72: cost-allocation clause (由...承担) without a modal verb; statement adds 'adverse reactions' from Article 56 context.
rows.quote_en: Compensation costs required for vaccination with non-immunisation-programme vaccines are borne by the relevant vaccine marketing authorisation holder.

f.title: Establish a lifecycle QMS, implement a post-marketing risk management plan and conduct post-marketing studies
f.statement: Vaccine MAHs shall establish and improve a whole-lifecycle quality management system, formulate and implement a post-marketing risk management plan, and conduct post-marketing studies to further confirm vaccine safety, efficacy and quality controllability.
f.clause: 第五十七条第一款 (Article 57(1)), Chapter VII post-marketing management
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人应当建立健全疫苗全生命周期质量管理体系，制定并实施疫苗上市后风险管理计划，开展疫苗上市后研究，对疫苗的安全性、有效性和质量可控性进行进一步确证。
rows.location: 第五十七条第一款 (Article 57(1)), Chapter VII post-marketing management
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the MAH duties; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Vaccine marketing authorisation holders shall establish and improve a quality management system covering the whole life cycle of vaccines, formulate and implement a post-marketing risk management plan for vaccines, and conduct post-marketing studies of vaccines to further confirm vaccine safety, efficacy and quality controllability.

f.title: Complete required post-approval studies within the set period
f.statement: For vaccines with further study requirements set at registration approval, the MAH shall complete the studies within the specified period; if not completed on time or benefit cannot be shown to outweigh risk, NMPA shall act, up to cancelling the registration certificate.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100). Vaccines with further study requirements set at registration approval.

rows.deadline: Within the period specified at approval
rows.quote: 对批准疫苗注册申请时提出进一步研究要求的疫苗，疫苗上市许可持有人应当在规定期限内完成研究；逾期未完成研究或者不能证明其获益大于风险的，国务院药品监督管理部门应当依法处理，直至注销该疫苗的药品注册证书。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the duty and NMPA consequence; deadline depends on the approval; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: For vaccines for which further study requirements were set when the vaccine registration application was approved, the vaccine marketing authorisation holder shall complete the studies within the prescribed period; where the studies are not completed within the period or it cannot be demonstrated that the benefits outweigh the risks, the drug regulatory department of the State Council shall deal with the matter according to law, up to cancelling the drug registration certificate of the vaccine.

f.title: Continuously update package insert and labels based on post-marketing studies and AEFIs
f.statement: Vaccine MAHs shall continuously update the package insert and labels based on post-marketing studies, adverse events following immunization and other information, and apply for approval or filing as required.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人应当根据疫苗上市后研究、预防接种异常反应等情况持续更新说明书、标签，并按照规定申请核准或者备案。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the labeling update duty; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Vaccine marketing authorisation holders shall continuously update the package insert and labels on the basis of post-marketing studies, abnormal reactions to vaccination and other information, and apply for approval or filing as required.

f.title: Report annually on production, post-marketing studies and risk management
f.statement: Vaccine MAHs shall establish a quality review analysis and risk reporting system and each year truthfully report production and distribution, post-marketing studies, risk management and related matters to NMPA as required.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人应当建立疫苗质量回顾分析和风险报告制度，每年将疫苗生产流通、上市后研究、风险管理等情况按照规定如实向国务院药品监督管理部门报告。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the annual report duty; detail "按照规定" set elsewhere; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Vaccine marketing authorisation holders shall establish a vaccine quality review analysis and risk reporting system and each year report truthfully, as required, on vaccine production and distribution, post-marketing studies, risk management and other matters to the drug regulatory department of the State Council.

f.title: Conduct post-marketing evaluation when ordered by NMPA
f.statement: NMPA may, according to actual circumstances, order vaccine MAHs to conduct a post-marketing evaluation or organise one directly. When ordered, the MAH shall conduct the post-marketing evaluation.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).
f.exceptions: Applies only when NMPA issues an order (责令); NMPA may instead organise the evaluation itself.

rows.actor: Vaccine marketing authorisation holder, when ordered by NMPA
rows.quote: 国务院药品监督管理部门可以根据实际情况，责令疫苗上市许可持有人开展上市后评价或者直接组织开展上市后评价。
rows.review_note: Review: level Permitted -> Mandatory. 可以 is NMPA's discretion; 责令 is an order that the MAH must carry out. Restated as a conditional duty, consistent with the authority-order rows in the TW files. Double-check: Mandatory accepted: statement is framed as the MAH duty to conduct the evaluation once ordered, and 责令 (order) in the quote is a binding order on the MAH; the duty itself is implied rather than stated; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 68: MAH duty implied by 责令 (NMPA order), not stated.
rows.quote_en: The drug regulatory department of the State Council may, according to actual circumstances, order the vaccine marketing authorisation holder to conduct a post-marketing evaluation, or directly organise a post-marketing evaluation.

f.title: Stop sale and use of vaccines with suspected quality problems and report
f.statement: Where a vaccine has or is suspected to have a quality problem, the MAH shall immediately stop sale, distribution and use, stop production if necessary, and report to the drug regulatory and health departments at or above county level as required.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗存在或者疑似存在质量问题的，疫苗上市许可持有人、疾病预防控制机构、接种单位应当立即停止销售、配送、使用，必要时立即停止生产，按照规定向县级以上人民政府药品监督管理部门、卫生健康主管部门报告。
rows.review_note: Review: kept in PV scope; the quote names the MAH, and stopping sale and use of vaccines with suspected quality or safety defects is a product safety duty. No change. Double-check: quote proves the MAH duties; quality-defect handling is at the PV/quality boundary; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Where a vaccine has or is suspected to have a quality problem, the vaccine marketing authorisation holder, centres for disease control and prevention and vaccination units shall immediately stop sale, distribution and use, immediately stop production when necessary, and report as required to the drug regulatory departments and health departments of the people's governments at or above county level.

f.title: Notify stakeholders and recall sold vaccines with quality problems, keeping records
f.statement: For vaccines already sold, the MAH shall promptly notify the relevant CDCs, distribution units and vaccination units, recall the vaccines as required, and truthfully record the recall and notification.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 对已经销售的疫苗，疫苗上市许可持有人应当及时通知相关疾病预防控制机构、疫苗配送单位、接种单位，按照规定召回，如实记录召回和通知情况
rows.review_note: Review: kept in PV scope; the quote names the MAH (recall of vaccines with safety or quality defects). Quote ends before 'the CDCs etc. shall cooperate'. No change. Double-check: quote proves the MAH notification, recall and record duties; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: For vaccines already sold, the vaccine marketing authorisation holder shall promptly notify the relevant centres for disease control and prevention, vaccine distribution units and vaccination units, recall the vaccines as required, and truthfully record the recall and notification

f.title: Do not conceal, falsely or late report vaccine quality problems
f.statement: MAHs that find vaccines with existing or suspected quality problems shall not conceal, falsely report, delay or omit reporting, nor hide, forge or destroy relevant evidence.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人、疾病预防控制机构、接种单位发现存在或者疑似存在质量问题的疫苗，不得瞒报、谎报、缓报、漏报，不得隐匿、伪造、毁灭有关证据。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the prohibition; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Vaccine marketing authorisation holders, centres for disease control and prevention and vaccination units that discover vaccines with an existing or suspected quality problem shall not conceal, falsely report, delay reporting or omit reporting, and shall not hide, forge or destroy related evidence.

f.title: Publish vaccine product information, package insert and labels, and recall information on the website
f.statement: Vaccine MAHs shall establish an information disclosure system and promptly publish on their website product information, package insert and labels, GxP compliance, lot release, recalls, inspections and penalties, and compulsory liability insurance.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人应当建立信息公开制度，按照规定在其网站上及时公开疫苗产品信息、说明书和标签、药品相关质量管理规范执行情况、批签发情况、召回情况、接受检查和处罚情况以及投保疫苗责任强制保险情况等信息。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the disclosure duty; content and timing "按照规定" set elsewhere; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Vaccine marketing authorisation holders shall establish an information disclosure system and promptly disclose on their websites, as required, vaccine product information, package inserts and labels, implementation of the relevant good practices for drugs, lot release, recalls, inspections and penalties received, compulsory vaccine liability insurance taken out and other information.

f.title: Do not release unified vaccine safety information without authorisation
f.statement: Vaccine safety risk warnings, major vaccine safety incidents and their investigation and handling, and other vaccine safety information that the State Council designates for unified publication are published by NMPA together with the relevant departments; the national status of reported abnormal reactions to vaccination (AEFI) is published by the national health authority together with NMPA. This information may not be released without authorisation.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.actor: Vaccine marketing authorisation holder (and any entity or individual; the clause has no named subject)
rows.quote: 疫苗安全风险警示信息、重大疫苗安全事故及其调查处理信息和国务院确定需要统一公布的其他疫苗安全信息，由国务院药品监督管理部门会同有关部门公布。全国预防接种异常反应报告情况，由国务院卫生健康主管部门会同国务院药品监督管理部门统一公布。未经授权不得发布上述信息。
rows.review_note: Review: added (missed). Article 76 limits who may publish vaccine safety information. Under 76(3) the MAH may be called on to help verify misleading information. Double-check: scope narrowed: quote cut to Article 76(2) on unauthorised release; Article 76(3) (authority verifies misleading information with, among others, the MAH) imposes no MAH duty and was dropped; Article 76(4) false-information ban split out to new row -0021. The clause 未经授权不得发布 has no subject, so applying it to the MAH is inferred; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 60: subjectless 未经授权不得发布; MAH actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: Vaccine safety risk warning information, information on major vaccine safety accidents and their investigation and handling, and other vaccine safety information that the State Council determines needs unified publication are published by the drug regulatory department of the State Council together with the relevant departments. The national situation of reported abnormal reactions to vaccination is published uniformly by the health department of the State Council together with the drug regulatory department of the State Council. The above information shall not be released without authorisation.

f.title: Do not fabricate or spread false vaccine safety information
f.statement: No entity or individual, including a vaccine MAH, may fabricate or spread false vaccine safety information.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.actor: Any entity or individual, including the vaccine marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: 任何单位和个人不得编造、散布虚假疫苗安全信息。
rows.review_note: Double-check: added by split from -0020 (Article 76(4)) so each row carries one duty. The quote proves the prohibition on any entity or individual; the MAH is covered by inference; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 80: 任何单位和个人 covers the MAH by inference.
rows.quote_en: No entity or individual shall fabricate or spread false vaccine safety information.

f.title: Prepare a vaccine safety incident handling plan and check preventive measures regularly
f.statement: Vaccine MAHs shall formulate a vaccine safety incident handling plan, regularly check the implementation of preventive measures and promptly eliminate safety hazards.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 疫苗上市许可持有人应当制定疫苗安全事件处置方案，定期检查各项防范措施的落实情况，及时消除安全隐患。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves the MAH duties; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: Vaccine marketing authorisation holders shall formulate a vaccine safety incident handling plan, regularly check the implementation of all preventive measures and promptly eliminate safety hazards.

f.title: Report vaccine safety incidents immediately to NMPA or the provincial drug regulator
f.statement: When a vaccine safety incident occurs, the MAH shall immediately report to NMPA or the provincial drug regulatory department.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 发生疫苗安全事件，疫苗上市许可持有人应当立即向国务院药品监督管理部门或者省、自治区、直辖市人民政府药品监督管理部门报告
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Note that CDCs, vaccination units and medical institutions report to the health and drug authorities; the MAH reports to NMPA or the provincial drug regulator. Double-check: quote proves the MAH immediate reporting duty and recipients; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level follows 应当/不得 (Mandatory); actor named in the quote; statement adds nothing; earlier hold below 90 for being a translation is lifted per GUIDE "Non-English sources".
rows.quote_en: When a vaccine safety incident occurs, the vaccine marketing authorisation holder shall immediately report to the drug regulatory department of the State Council or to the drug regulatory department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government

f.title: Bear revaccination costs for safety incidents caused by quality problems
f.statement: Revaccination costs for vaccine safety incidents caused by quality problems are borne by the vaccine MAH.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.quote: 因质量问题造成的疫苗安全事件的补种费用由疫苗上市许可持有人承担。
rows.review_note: Review: kept in PV scope; the quote names the MAH (it bears revaccination costs for safety incidents caused by quality problems). No change. Double-check: cost-allocation clause without a modal verb, so Mandatory is a judgement; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 75: cost-allocation clause without a modal verb.
rows.quote_en: Revaccination costs for vaccine safety incidents caused by quality problems are borne by the vaccine marketing authorisation holder.

f.title: Do not conceal or falsely, late or incompletely report vaccine safety incidents
f.statement: Relevant units and individuals shall not conceal, falsely report, delay or omit reporting vaccine safety incidents, nor hide, forge or destroy related evidence.
f.applicability: China; Vaccine Administration Law (Chinese original, NPC; not a translation). In force from 1 December 2019 (Article 100).

rows.actor: Relevant units and individuals, including the vaccine MAH
rows.quote: 有关单位和个人不得瞒报、谎报、缓报、漏报疫苗安全事件，不得隐匿、伪造、毁灭有关证据。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor "relevant units and individuals" includes the MAH by inference; English statement of a Chinese quote, so held below 90 per GUIDE. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; held at 82: 有关单位和个人 covers the MAH by inference.
rows.quote_en: Entities and individuals concerned shall not conceal, falsely report, delay reporting or omit reporting vaccine safety incidents, and shall not hide, forge or destroy related evidence.
